narrative:
Cost of care is planned at GBP 2.82B for FY2027 — 74.1% of revenue — from four drivers: claims incurred and medical costs (62%), the clinical and care workforce (19%), medical supplies and third-party care (12%), and commissions and reserve movement (7%).

Medical inflation of 6.8% is the largest single driver: hospital tariffs, outpatient diagnostics and cancer-care severity push the average claim cost up faster than frequency. Mental-health claims are the fastest-growing pathway, led by the North region and Individual PMI.

In provision, agency staffing above the 9% target adds a premium to the cost per clinical FTE — converting agency hours to permanent roles is the main controllable lever.

signals.title: Bupa Insurance Ltd combined operating ratio stable at 97%
signals.excerpt: The COR for Bupa Insurance Limited, which underwrites both domestic and international insurance, remained stable at 97%, against 94% for the Group.

signals.title: Group Solvency II coverage 189%
signals.excerpt: Own funds £6.8bn against an SCR of £3.6bn — above the 140–170% working range; a 2% worse loss ratio would reduce coverage to 182%.
